relations.reading: A bounded provisional declaration can enable discovery without being mistaken for the binding ownership decision that the investigation is meant to inform.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: A focused intervention can begin with a bounded discovery mandate without confusing provisional assumptions with the binding decisions required for production change.

relations.title: Bloqueo de mapas actual y objetivo
relations.reading: A reversible provisional declaration can help discover a route between current and target states, while keeping exploration separate from an irreversible ownership or retirement decision.
